description: The line plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates the accuracy (Pass@8) of three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” spans from 62.5 to 80.0, with major gridlines at 2.5-unit intervals. The orange line with triangle markers represents On-policy RL, which starts at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, rises to a peak of ~75.0 at 0.8, then dips to ~71.0 at 0.9 before recovering slightly to ~73.5 at 1.0. The red line with star markers, corresponding to LUFFY, begins at ~76.0, peaks at ~79.5 near 0.8, and ends at ~80.0 at 1.0, showing overall high and stable performance with minor fluctuations. The teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, representing SFT, starts at ~76.0, dips to ~70.0 at 0.5, rises to ~76.5 at 0.6, then fluctuates between ~72.0 and ~74.5 before ending at ~74.5 at 1.0. All three lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with LUFFY consistently outperforming the others across most temperatures.
